title: Round Totals
description:
`points` holds the points a team scored in each round of a long match, round 0 first. Each entry of `queries` is `[from, to]` (inclusive, 0-based, `from <= to`).

Return, for every query in order, the total points scored from round `from` through round `to`. The largest test has 20,000 rounds and 12,000 queries, so answer each query without re-adding the whole range.
